name: dsamin/story-time
description: A calm iPad read-aloud app for a 4-year-old: hear a tiny decodable story, then tap to answer who/what/where and drag pictures back into order. Audio-first, errorless, fully offline. Comprehension + memory (app 4 of 5).

name: dsamin/trace-and-read
description: iPad app that teaches a 4-year-old letter formation, then bridges it straight into reading: he writes his name and CVC words stroke by stroke, then the app blends the letters aloud so the word he just wrote becomes a word he can read. Audio-first, errorless, calm, fully offline, zero third-party deps.

name: dsamin/stretchy-sounds
description: A calm, audio-first iPad phonics app that teaches a 4-year-old to read CVC words by stretching each letter sound and sliding them together — synthetic phonics with an audible blend, no fails, no scores. SwiftUI, iPadOS 17+, fully offline. Build 2 of 5; defines the shared LearningKit chassis.

name: dsamin/sound-catcher
description: Letter-free iPad phonemic-awareness game for a 4-year-old: a warm voice asks "Which one says ssss?" and he taps the picture. Errorless, calm, fully offline SwiftUI. App 1 of 5 — establishes the shared LearningKit chassis (content DB, audio engine, mastery/review).
